agent.reasons: Beneficial ownership is incomplete. A 30% stake is held by an unknown party, and Granite Holdings LLC holds 44% but its owners are unknown and it is not shown to be an excluded entity. Either stake could hide an unidentified person who owns 25% or more, so SOP 3.3 calls for requesting documents. Every other check passed: Mateo Weiss is identified as control person and is verified, all screening is clear, the registry filing from 2026-01-15 is less than 12 months old, the industry is normal and the location is the US. None of these raises the outcome above request documents.
still_needed: Who holds the unaccounted 30% ownership stake
Who owns Granite Holdings LLC (any individual with an indirect share of 25% or more), or proof that it is an excluded entity under 31 CFR 1010.230(e)(2)
ID verification and screening (sanctions, PEP, adverse media, location) for any newly identified 25%+ owners
